subject.title: [Bug]: Teams app removal/re-add retains prior DM session history

question: Should OpenClaw treat bot-visible Teams app removal/reinstall lifecycle signals as a privacy/session boundary, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100371 be the canonical fix over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100350?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the final boundary affects retained personal-chat history, proactive conversation references, and the product claim for Teams-local clear-history flows that emit no bot-visible signal.

options.title: Land scoped lifecycle reset
options.body: Review and land the stronger scoped lifecycle/session-reset PR while documenting that Teams-local clear-history without a bot-visible signal cannot be detected.

options.title: Define broader forget policy
options.body: Pause both PRs until maintainers define a user-facing Teams forget/reset policy that covers local clear-history expectations without platform lifecycle events.

options.title: Reject server-side reset
options.body: Treat Teams removal and clear-history behavior as outside OpenClaw's session boundary and document that retained server-side session history is expected.

recommendation.title: Land scoped lifecycle reset
recommendation.body: Review and land the stronger scoped lifecycle/session-reset PR while documenting that Teams-local clear-history without a bot-visible signal cannot be detected.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Teams state storage and security-sensitive channel behavior adjacent to retained conversation references.
